translations.terms.title: Terms of sale and cancellation
translations.terms.metaDescription: Rates, cancellation, no-show, payment and tourist tax of Hôtel Riad Vieux-Port, in Marseille.
translations.terms.fictional: Fictional hotel: these terms illustrate a demonstration website and bind no one.
translations.terms.flexible: Flexible rate: nothing is paid when booking. A bank card is required as a guarantee; the stay is paid at the hotel.
translations.terms.nonRefundable: Non-refundable rate: {$discount} % less than the flexible rate, the stay is paid when booking. It can be neither changed nor refunded.
translations.terms.cancel: At the flexible rate, cancellation is free until {$hours} hours before the day of arrival at {$time}; after that, the first night is charged to the guarantee card.
translations.terms.noShow: In case of no-show, the first night is due at the flexible rate; at the non-refundable rate, the stay paid remains with the hotel.
translations.terms.payment: Online payment is made on the secure page of Stripe: the hotel neither receives nor keeps any bank card data. The tourist tax, set by the city, is paid at the hotel.
translations.terms.stay: Rooms are available from {$checkIn} on the day of arrival and must be vacated before {$checkOut} on the day of departure. For any question: {$phone}.

translations.privacy.controller: The data controller is Hôtel Riad Vieux-Port, a fictional establishment. For any question about your data or to exercise your rights, write to:
translations.privacy.dataIntro: When you book, we only ask for what the stay needs:
translations.privacy.dataIdentity: your first and last name, your e-mail, your phone number and your country;
translations.privacy.dataStay: the dates, the rooms, the number of guests and the age of the children;
translations.privacy.dataMessage: your language and, if you write one, your message to the hotel.
translations.privacy.dataCard: Your bank card is typed on the secure page of Stripe: the hotel never receives nor keeps it.
translations.privacy.purposeBooking: handle your booking and your stay, and write to you about them: performance of the contract;
translations.privacy.purposePayment: collect the payment, the cancellation or no-show fees: performance of the contract;
translations.privacy.purposeLaw: keep the accounts and meet the legal obligations of the hotel: legal obligation.
translations.privacy.noMarketing: Your data is never used for advertising and never sold.
translations.privacy.retention: The data of a booking is kept for 3 years after the stay, then archived. Accounting records, such as invoices, are kept for 10 years, as the law requires.
translations.privacy.recipientStaff: the staff of the hotel, according to their role (reception, management);
translations.privacy.recipientStripe: Stripe, for the payment and the guarantee card;
translations.privacy.recipientBrevo: Brevo, to send the e-mails of confirmation and cancellation.
translations.privacy.transfers: Brevo processes the data in the European Union. Stripe may process it in the United States: this transfer is covered by the safeguards of the GDPR (standard contractual clauses of the European Commission).
translations.privacy.cookies: The site sets no advertising or audience measurement cookie. During a booking, your details are kept in the tab of your browser so that you do not type them again; they are erased when it is closed. The payment page of Stripe uses its own cookies, needed for the security of the payment.
translations.privacy.rights: You may access your data, have it corrected or erased, limit its use, object to it and receive it in a common format. Write to the address above: we answer within one month.
translations.privacy.cnil: If you consider that your rights are not respected, you may complain to the CNIL (French data protection authority):
translations.privacy.security: The site is served over HTTPS. The « Manage my booking » link sent by e-mail is secret and personal: the hotel keeps only a fingerprint of it, never the link itself.
